address: Moor Hall Drive, Four Oaks, Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham,B75 6LN
bio: Located in Sutton Coldfield near Birmingham, Moor Hall Hotel & Spa is the perfect place to relax and enjoy the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea. The hall was built by Colonel Edward Ansell of Ansell Brewery fame as his private residence in 1905 and is now the perfect place to relax and enjoy a traditional English Afternoon Tea with friends.  In the summer sit outside in the sunshine and enjoy the fabulous views over the sweeping lawns from the flower filled terrace; in winter, enjoy a cosy afternoon in the original oak panelled Lounge Bar or Ladywood Room in front of a roaring fire.  Starting at £26 per person, Moor Hall's Afternoon Tea offers include the Classic, the Celebration with a glass of sparkling prosecco and the Festive which is the ultimate pre-Christmas treat (available in December only).
